items.body:
Minor release focused on safer logging, more reliable theme upgrades, and cleaner header behavior. Municipio adds migration handling for empty default tokens and aligns header layouts with the latest Styleguide update, while Stream hardens multisite access and redacts sensitive integration data from logs.

## Municipio Theme [7.16.1...7.17.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.16.1...7.17.2)
- Handles empty default design tokens during migration to reduce upgrade issues in existing setups.
- Updates header layouts to follow the latest Styleguide settings more consistently.
- Fixes button rendering so the correct style setting is used.

## Styleguide [3.17.22...3.18.0](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.17.22...3.18.0)
- Lets standard headers use width settings even when header padding is turned off.

## Stream Activity Log [4.3.0...4.4.0](https://github.com/xwp/stream/blob/master/changelog.md#440---august-31-2026)
- Tightens multisite access so activity records stay scoped to the current site, and network-wide settings now require network-level permission.
- Redacts integration secrets and alert destination credentials from logs and alert data output.
- Fixes false “SITE IS DISCONNECTED” CLI errors on empty sites, an early capability-check fatal error, and an unknown-user password reset warning.

Minor release focused on editor flexibility and front-end stability. Municipio lets editors manage custom CSS, hardens generated image handling, restores schema-based taxonomy creation, and fixes missing header items. The updated Styleguide improves menu and drawer positioning, respects disabled header padding, and fixes inherited button contrast.

## Municipio Theme [7.14.5...7.16.1](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.14.5...7.16.1)
- Image Conversion: Prevents broken or half-written generated images from being published, and falls back to the original image if conversion fails.
- Schema Taxonomies: Restores taxonomy creation for schema types and makes sure schema-specific taxonomy filters run correctly.
- Header Layout: Keeps mobile-only and responsive header items aligned and visible instead of dropping them from the layout.
- Custom CSS Permissions: Editors can now edit Customizer CSS on multisite setups without requiring higher-level access.

## Styleguide [3.17.12...3.17.22](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.17.12...3.17.22)
- Mega Menu Positioning: Aligns full-width dropdowns correctly so they open in the expected place.
- Header Padding: Respects disabled horizontal header padding to avoid unwanted spacing.
- Button Contrast: Basic buttons now inherit the correct contrast color for clearer text on inherited color themes.
- Drawer Layering: Raises the drawer and overlay above surrounding content so the menu stays clickable and visible.
- Map Library: Updates the bundled OpenStreetMap library to the latest version.

Minor release: this update focuses on Municipio and its UI layer, adding Kulturkortet purchase and renewal flows, more flexible header and footer behavior, custom taxonomy mapping for schema data, and clearer chat error handling. It also improves search, forms, guides, and JSON-rendered content with a set of targeted stability and frontend fixes.

Municipio Theme [\[7.7.68...7.14.5\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.7.68...7.14.5)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Kulturkortet:** Adds purchase and renewal links in the profile flow and strengthens ticket validation, including support for developer impersonation during testing.
*   **Schema Mapping:** Adds support for mapping schema properties to custom taxonomies.
*   **Header and Footer:** Modernizes header and footer implementations, reduces reliance on older Kirki-based settings, and improves migration of older footer and drawer settings.
*   **Header Layout:** Improves dropdown behavior, mobile fallback, overlap handling, upper and lower header visibility, and compatibility with older header surface tokens.
*   **Chat:** Lets chat bubbles be shown on specific pages and adds clearer frontend error messages when chat requests fail.
*   **Content and Navigation:** Fixes post list block heights, filter button placement, active menu states, hero width, long page-title wrapping, and bottom sidebar placement.
*   **Admin and Data:** Fixes interactive map markers, custom post type archive slugs, single post type admin links, school description handling, school alerts, and location descriptions for pre- and elementary schools.
- **Kirki Removal:** Completes the removal of the Kirki framework from Municipio and migrates remaining Customizer, header, color, and styling settings to native or design-tool based implementations.
- **Customizer:** Restores live preview for custom CSS and ensures error pages are correctly displayed while being customized.
- **Header and Logotypes:** Adds fluid brand and logotype scaling with sensible minimum and maximum sizes, including native support for sticky headers, and restores login/logout styling across header and drawer components.
- **Header Configuration:** Moves width and color controls into the design tool, removes the deprecated accent-line option, and avoids showing login/logout controls when their intended state cannot be determined.
- **Colors:** Uses color swatches from the design tool in the Customizer and deprecates unrestricted color selection.
- **Accessibility and Navigation:** Enables quick-jump links for content and the main menu in the flexible header.
- **Legacy Migration:** Removes the Casual and Business header variants and automatically migrates them to the Flexible header.
- **CSS Editing:** Removes the separate admin CSS editor and migrates custom CSS editing to the native Customizer CSS editor.

Styleguide [\[2.281.17...3.17.12\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/2.281.17...3.17.12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Runtime Support:** Moves the package forward from PHP 8.2-era tooling and standardizes the build setup around PHP 8.3.
*   **Header and Footer Controls:** Adds footer settings and new header controls for padding, gap, color scheme, and logo scale, while retiring older business and casual header variants.
*   **Brand and Logotype Scaling:** Adds autoscaling, aspect-ratio support, width clamping, selectable scaling curves, and safer defaults for brands and logotypes.
*   **Design Controls:** Improves design-builder controls with multi-output support, line-height settings, min and max range controls, smoother sliders, and broader font-weight selection.
*   **New UI and Fixes:** Adds a collapsible search component and fixes accordion heading styling, sticky FAB overflow, field heights, icon-link underlines, Blade cache cleanup, and missing modal gallery images.

Algolia Index [\[3.5.10...3.5.12\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/algolia-index/compare/3.5.10...3.5.12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Search Configuration:** Delays reading ACF settings so search configuration loads more reliably during startup.

Algolia Index Typesense Provider [\[1.0.15...1.0.17\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/algolia-index-typesense-provider/compare/1.0.15...1.0.17)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Frontend Search Access:** Uses the public Typesense search key in the browser configuration so frontend search can authenticate correctly.

Modularity Frontend Form [\[0.83.4...0.83.14\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-frontend-form/compare/0.83.4...0.83.14)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Map Fields:** Fixes cases where map fields did not load correctly.
*   **Field Presentation:** Improves styling for non-standard field labels and updates spacing values to rem-based sizing for more consistent rendering.
*   **Loading States:** Fixes positioning and layering issues in working and loading overlays so form feedback stays visible.

Modularity Guides [\[5.0.8...5.0.12\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-guides/compare/5.0.8...5.0.12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Accordion Behavior:** Fixes accordion expansion so button clicks open and close sections correctly.
*   **Frontend Dependencies:** Removes the jQuery dependency, simplifying the frontend runtime.

Modularity JSON Render [\[4.0.8...4.0.14\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render/compare/4.0.8...4.0.14)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Markup Cleanup:** Removes unwanted spaces between generated CSS classes.
*   **Accordion Rendering:** Fixes React-rendered accordion markup, styling, and behavior so rendered accordions match the current implementation.

Modularity Recommend [\[4.2.0...4.2.2\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-recommend/compare/4.2.0...4.2.2)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Recommendation Script:** Fixes missing semicolons in the inline RekAI script to prevent frontend JavaScript errors.

Minor release: This update improves Municipio with faster hero image loading, better mobile behavior in backdrop banners, and more reliable manual post selection across languages. It also fixes content display in easy-to-read views and alarm integration asset loading.

## Municipio Theme [6.40.4...6.43.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/6.40.4...6.43.2)
- Hero image preloading: Preloads hero images from modules and widget-based modules to improve initial page loading.
- ACF manual post selection: Manual post selection now works more reliably across languages instead of depending on the current language context.
- Backdrop banner mobile layout: Improves mobile behavior, removes unwanted hover effects, and makes the banner more responsive on smaller screens.
- Template stability: Fixes multiple rendering warnings in hero, signature, archive, posts, text, event, and index views when expected data is missing.
- File handling: Skips files that no longer exist to avoid processing errors.

## Easy To Read Alternative [3.0.8...3.0.9](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/easy-to-read-alternative/compare/3.0.8...3.0.9)
- Easy-to-read content: The alternative reading version now appears correctly when content is rendered through Municipio PostObject, including relevant single and archive-based views.

## API Alarm Integration [5.0.9...5.0.11](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-alarm-integration/compare/5.0.9...5.0.11)
- Asset loading: Fixes how scripts and built assets are loaded so the alarm integration works correctly with the current `assets/dist` build output.

# Municipio 5.9.6

Adds beta version of AI chat in Municipio, improves multilingual navigation and async menu loading, and fixes post list behavior and REST endpoint handling. Supporting modules also harden form payload handling and prevent front-end rendering issues when translations are missing.

---

## Modularity Form Builder [4.0.8…4.0.10]
https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-form-builder/compare/4.0.8...4.0.10

- **Form Payload Handling:** Invalid or malformed encrypted payloads are now ignored safely instead of being decrypted, reducing the risk of broken form processing.

---

## Modularity JSON Render [4.0.4…4.0.6]
https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render/compare/4.0.4...4.0.6

- **Translation Safety:** The front-end now checks for missing translations before rendering, preventing broken output when translated labels are incomplete.

---

## Modularity Open Street Map [3.1.6…3.1.8]
https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-open-street-map/compare/3.1.6...3.1.8

- **Upstream Changelog:** No user-facing functional changes were listed in the available compare data for this patch release.

---

## Municipio Theme [6.38.19…6.40.4]
https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/6.38.19...6.40.4

- **AI Chat (BETA):** Adds an optional Eneo-based chat feature with configurable assistants, a global chat bubble, page module support, and streamed responses.
- **Navigation API:** Fixes async child-menu REST URLs and improves branch resolution so nested navigation loads more reliably.
- **Polylang Navigation:** Improves translated page, post type, archive, and breadcrumb links to reduce broken paths in multilingual navigation.
- **Posts Module:** Excludes the current post from post queries to prevent self-referential loops in related or listed content.
- **Async Posts List:** Removes the requirement for a filter form so async post lists continue working when no form is present.
- **Backdrop Banner:** Fixes slider height behavior and cleans up navigation content visibility in the banner layout.

---

## WP Page for Post Type [2.0.12…2.0.14]
https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wp-page-for-post-type/compare/2.0.12...2.0.14

- **Upstream Changelog:** No user-facing functional changes were listed in the available compare data for this patch release.

---

## Remove User Endpoint [0.2.2…0.2.3]
https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-remove-user-endpoint/compare/0.2.2...0.2.3

- **REST API Protection:** User endpoints are now fully unregistered for logged-out visitors instead of being blocked later in the request.
- **Error Handling:** Prevents access-control errors from bubbling up through the REST stack and causing secondary failures.
